text:
Priya Shah: Hey all — we need to lock the week-of workshop + drop-in schedule for the Migration Atelier next month. Customers: 6 total; 3 require advanced schema migration walkthroughs.
Liam Chen: +1, we should protect a 60m deep-dive and two 30m office hours. prefer spread across timezones.
Diego Rivera: Can we do one session focused on Dedicated capacity sizing and another on private deployment network checklist? those are the heavy asks.
Maya Patel: My availability: Tue 09:00-13:00 PST, Wed 12:00-16:00 CET. I can lead the network checklist.
Nate Gomez: I can run the Dedicated sizing session. prefer Wed 10:00-12:00 PST.
Priya Shah: Proposed slots (pick 2 primary + 2 overflow):
- Option A: Tue 16:00 UTC (60m deep-dive)
- Option B: Wed 18:00 UTC (60m deep-dive alternate)
- Option C: Thu 14:00 UTC (30m office hours x2 back-to-back)
- Option D: Fri 09:00 UTC (30m office hours x2 back-to-back)
Priya Shah: Quick poll: react with :one: for A, :two: for B, :three: for C, :four: for D. also comment if you'd rather swap deep-dive + office hours ordering.
Liam Chen: :one: for team availability, :three: for customer-friendly slots (APAC coverage).
Diego Rivera: :two: because Nate is in PST and we need overlap for infra folks.
Maya Patel: :one: works for me. I can prep the VPC checklist doc.
Nate Gomez: :two: from me. if B wins, I can do Dedicated sizing then.
Priya Shah: Cool — tie-breaker: Liam, can you confirm with the two enterprise customers that requested deep-dive if Option B is okay? (they're EMEA heavy)
Liam Chen: Yup pinged them: Acme Health says B is preferred; Kestrel Labs prefers A but flexible. both asked for a short pre-read.
Priya Shah: Draft agenda for the 60m deep-dive (feel free to edit):
```
00-05m - intros + goals
05-20m - migration strategy overview (Priya)
20-40m - Dedicated capacity sizing + benchmarks (Nate)
40-55m - VPC/network checklist + hardening (Maya)
55-60m - next steps + followups
```
Priya Shah: Prep checklist for leads: share pre-read 72h before, attach example infra terraform snippet, include expected customer scale and current token volumes.
Priya Shah: Example terraform snippet for pre-read:
```terraform
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "size_example" {
  gpus = 4
  region = "us-west-2"
  max_concurrency = 120
}
```
Diego Rivera: I'll assemble a short benchmark table to include in the pre-read.
Maya Patel: I'll own the VPC snippet + network diagram.
Onboard Bot: Calendar event created: Migration Atelier — Deep-dive (Option B) — Wed 18:00 UTC. Invitees: Acme Health, Kestrel Labs, Internal leads. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1756007001
Priya Shah: Thanks bot. Please also create two overflow 30m office-hour events (Thu 14:00 UTC and Fri 09:00 UTC) and enable 10 attendee capacity each.
Onboard Bot: Overflow events created. Capacity set to 10 seats each. RSVP link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/atelier/dropins/1756007001
Liam Chen: I'll reach out to customers about the pre-read deadline and collect their expected scale numbers.
Nate Gomez: I'll draft a short slide with sizing heuristics and costs (p95 latency targets + cost per 1k tokens) and drop in #docs by EOD tomorrow.
Priya Shah: Awesome. Can someone take post-session feedback capture? we usually send a 3-question form and tag follow-ups in Gainsight.
Diego Rivera: I can build the 3-question form (technical clarity, actionability, follow-up priority).
Maya Patel: I'll create the Gainsight tasks for any follow-ups flagged high.
Priya Shah: Perfect — we'll reconvene Mon before the events for a 15m run-through. Meeting invite incoming.
Liam Chen: :thumbsup:
Nate Gomez: :raised_hands:
Diego Rivera: 👍
Priya Shah: Thanks team — leaving notes here so CS ops handoff is clean. Any objections to this plan?
Liam Chen: none. good to go.
Priya Shah: Great, closing thread.
